binding_policy: Bind every public declaration and no undocumented export.

safe_surface_values.internal: Used inside safe runtime or resource management; not exposed as a direct free function.
safe_surface_values.planned_m1: Contract is sufficient for the first safe facade.
safe_surface_values.planned_owned_output: May be exposed later only with immediate owned output copies.
safe_surface_values.implemented_m3: Exposed through the audited M3 owned-output or retained-input safe facade.
safe_surface_values.deferred_contract: Raw binding only until missing ownership, blocking, encoding, or thread contract is resolved.
safe_surface_values.implemented_m4: Exposed through the audited M4 registry/cookie callback facade with owned event delivery.
safe_surface_values.hidden_deprecated: Vendor-deprecated declaration retained only for raw ABI completeness.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetVersion
apis.ownership: SDK string pointer; copy immediately.
constraints: Returned pointer lifetime and maximum length are undocumented.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_Initialize
apis.ownership: Process-global SDK state.
constraints: Serialize globally.
Reinitialization after Finalize is undocumented.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_Finalize
apis.ownership: Ends process-global SDK state.
constraints: All safe device objects must be closed first.
Serialize globally.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetDeviceNumber
apis.ownership: Caller-owned scalar output.
constraints: Runtime must be initialized.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetDeviceList
apis.ownership: Caller-owned zeroed array and scalar output.
constraints: Validate returned count against capacity.
Handle discovery races with bounded retry.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_OpenDeviceByIP
apis.ownership: Caller-owned handle output; IP string borrowed for the call.
constraints: Initialize handle to null.
Construct Camera only on success with a non-null handle.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_OpenDeviceBySN
apis.ownership: Caller-owned handle output; serial string borrowed for the call.
constraints: Initialize handle to null.
Construct Camera only on success with a non-null handle.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_CloseDevice
apis.ownership: Consumes the safe handle state.
constraints: Invalidate the Rust handle after the call even when the SDK reports an error.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_SetIpConfig
apis.ownership: Input strings and structure borrowed for the call.
constraints: Validate IP text.
Zero all reserved bytes.
Serialize globally.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_RegisterExceptionCallBack
apis.ownership: SDK retains callback and user pointer for an undocumented lifetime.
constraints: Callback uses __stdcall on x86.
No native unregister or quiescence guarantee is documented.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_StartMeasure
apis.ownership: No transferred memory.
constraints: Valid only from the open state.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_StopMeasure
apis.ownership: No transferred memory.
constraints: Valid only from the measuring state.
Callback quiescence on return is undocumented.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_SoftTrigger
apis.ownership: No transferred memory.
constraints: Device trigger configuration remains an SDK precondition.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetImage
apis.ownership: SDK-owned output pointers; copy all payloads immediately.
constraints: Only finite timeout values 0 through 0xFFFFFFFE.
Validate pointer-length pairs and checked size arithmetic.
Do not expose borrowed frame views.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_RegisterImageDataCallBack
apis.ownership: SDK retains callback and user pointer; callback payload is SDK-owned.
constraints: Callback uses __stdcall on x86.
Do not call SDK APIs inside the callback.
Concurrency and quiescence are undocumented.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_ClearDataBuffer
apis.ownership: Mutates SDK-owned image buffers.
constraints: Exclusive device operation.
No safe borrowed SDK buffers may exist.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetParam
apis.ownership: Key borrowed for the call; caller-owned zeroed union output.
constraints: Validate the union discriminator before reading.
Validate nSupportedNum at most 16.
Treat fixed strings as bounded bytes.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_SetParam
apis.ownership: Key and tagged-union input borrowed for the call.
constraints: Construct only a matching active union member.
Zero inactive storage and reserved bytes.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_Execute
apis.ownership: Command key borrowed for the call.
constraints: Reject interior NUL.
Serialize with other device calls.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_FileAccessRead
apis.ownership: Both filename C strings are retained by Camera until observed completion or successful CloseDevice.
constraints: One transfer per camera.
A failed start faults the camera and retains names until close.
Filename encoding remains undocumented.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_FileAccessWrite
apis.ownership: Both filename C strings are retained by Camera until observed completion or successful CloseDevice.
constraints: One transfer per camera.
A failed start faults the camera and retains names until close.
Filename encoding remains undocumented.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetFileAccessProgress
apis.ownership: Caller-owned progress output.
constraints: Wrapper treats total > 0 and completed == total as complete.
After the first nonzero total, the total must remain stable.
Negative, excessive, or regressing progress is rejected without releasing retained names.
Cancellation remains unavailable.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetDeviceIP
apis.ownership: Caller buffer size is not represented in the signature.
constraints: Inside the vendor-marked deprecated API block.
Use GetDeviceList instead.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetDeviceSN
apis.ownership: Caller buffer size is not represented in the signature.
constraints: Inside the vendor-marked deprecated API block.
Use GetDeviceList instead.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetProfile
apis.ownership: Output pointer ownership and lifetime are undocumented.
constraints: Inside the vendor-marked deprecated API block.
Use GetImage instead.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetBatchProfile
apis.ownership: Output pointer ownership and lifetime are undocumented.
constraints: Inside the vendor-marked deprecated API block.
Use GetImage instead.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_GetIntensityData
apis.ownership: Output pointer ownership and lifetime are undocumented.
constraints: Inside the vendor-marked deprecated API block.
Use GetImage instead.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_RegisterProfileCallBack
apis.ownership: SDK retains callback and user pointer for an undocumented lifetime.
constraints: Inside the vendor-marked deprecated API block.
Callback uses __stdcall on x86.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_RegisterBatchProfileCallBack
apis.ownership: SDK retains callback and user pointer for an undocumented lifetime.
constraints: Inside the vendor-marked deprecated API block.
Callback uses __stdcall on x86.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_MapDepthToPointCloud
apis.ownership: Input borrowed for the call; reusable SDK-owned output copied immediately under the global gate.
constraints: Require Depth input.
Validate exact output type and length before copying.
Discard inherited auxiliary payloads if output dimensions change.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_MapDepthToPointCloudRound
apis.ownership: Input descriptor array borrowed for the call; reusable SDK-owned aggregate output copied immediately.
constraints: Image count from 1 through 8.
All inputs must be Depth.
Discard auxiliary pointers inherited from the first input.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_ImageConvert
apis.ownership: Installed 1.3.3.3 DLL uses a reusable SDK-owned output buffer even when caller storage is supplied; wrapper copies immediately.
constraints: Caller sets only the output image type in a zeroed descriptor.
Expose only the six documented conversion pairs.
Serialize and copy before any later ImgProc call.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_DepthMosaic
apis.ownership: Input descriptors and optional intensity planes are borrowed; SDK-owned depth and intensity outputs are copied immediately.
constraints: Image count from 1 through 8.
All inputs must be Depth.
Validate exact depth and optional intensity lengths.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_SaveImage
apis.ownership: Image and path pointers are borrowed; retention is undocumented.
constraints: Reject unsupported image/file-format pairs before FFI.
Path encoding is undocumented.
Filename is retained through the synchronous call.

apis.name: MV3D_LP_DisplayImage
apis.ownership: Image borrowed; external window handle ownership remains with the caller.
constraints: Available only with the Windows display-windows feature.
Borrow a Win32 handle through raw-window-handle for the synchronous call.
Mono8 does not support manual range.
